column1: # Files allowed to name the retired .gaia/local/(specs|plans|research) roots.
# Columns (tab-separated): file, reason, line-pattern (optional extended regex).
# A row without a line pattern allows every hit in the file; a row with one
# allows only the hit lines it matches. Live prose carries a pattern that
# matches only the lines describing the old roots as old. A row whose file has
# no hit is stale and fails the check.
